description: The graphomate charts are our IBCS®-certified charting component, which offer the six basic chart types necessary to realize a standardized notation within Microsoft Power BI. In addition to bar and column charts, you can use needle and stacked bar charts, as well as waterfall charts—for example, for P&L or contribution margin calculations—to illustrate a notation in accordance with IBCS®. Rich feature set to enhance your visuals Fully integrated into Power BI: drill downs, highlights, selections and tooltips are supported Integrated deviation charts - to analyze your data – no DAX scripting required Combine different chart types within a single visualization - Combination charts Comparison Group feature - for uniform scaling of different chart visuals within a report application Create small multiples - for all chart types to analyze trends across categories Cross-platform template sharing - to increase productivity and achieve consistent notation throughout your company dashboards Licensing Free to use in Power BI Desktop with all features The Power BI Online Service visual requires a subscription license to remove the watermark Contact us for time-limited demo licenses For more information visit: graphomate.com Get demo licenses
